learning_outcomes.text: Adequate knowledge of the concept of business, its institutional and legal framework. Business organization and management.

Ability to identify the main problems and challenges of our society and to propose, design and develop sustainable, innovative and participatory methodologies and/or technologies to improve people's lives, making responsible use of resources and knowing how to determine the impact that different projects have on the economy, society or the environment.

syllabus_topics: The company: concept, elements, and functions
The company as an economic production unit
Distinction between company and organization. The company as an organization
Typology and classification of organizations.
Perspectives of the company
Ownership, management, and governance of the company: Separation between ownership and control
The business objective: Profit versus value creation
Agents involved in setting business objectives
Business ethics and corporate social responsibility.
Business administration: Management and Administration.
Managerial functions and levels
Managerial functions: Planning, Organization, Human Resources Management, and Control.
Decisions in the field of Business Management
Definition of environment.
Typology of environments.
Analysis of the specific environment: Porter's model.
Concept of business strategy.
The environment as the basis of business strategy
Levels of business strategy.
Internationalization of the company
Production and Operations Management: concept, evolution, and scope.
The production and operations subsystem in the company. The production function
Definition of objectives and decisions in the production area
Financial Management: the concepts of investment and financing
Investment selection models.
Sources of financing.
Marketing: concept and evolution
Components and functions of Marketing
The Marketing Mix
assessment_rules: The general model is continuous assessment, with no individual activity exceeding 60% and non-re-evaluable activities not exceeding 40% of the global grade. The final grade is the sum of formative activities (30%) and a Theory-Practical Exam (70%). A minimum of 2.5 out of 5 points is required on the Theory-Practical Exam, and the overall minimum to pass the course is 5 points. Formative activities are not re-evaluable and their grade is only added if the Theory-Practical Exam is passed. Students can re-sit the Theory-Practical Exam in the extraordinary call.
